subject: general
question: Who won the BWF Female Para Badminton Player of the Year 2021?
solution:
Correct answer is__ Leani Ratri Oktila.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• **Leani Ratri Oktila** is **Indonesian Para badminton player.**
 
• She played each of the **three variations of the sport (women's singles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles) at the highest world level.**
 
• Due to disruption caused by COVID-19 over the past two years, the period of consideration for the awards was from** November 2019 until 31 October 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Complete List of Winners at Badminton World Federation (BWF)** awards.

 
• **Player of the Year: Viktor Axelsen** (Male)
 
• **Player of the Year: Tai Tzu Ying **(Female)
 
• **Most improved player of the Year: Lee Yang and Wang Chi-Lin**
 
• **Pair of the Year: Greysia Polii and Apriyani RahayuEddy Choong **
 
• **Most Promising Player: Kunlavut Vitidsarn (Male)**
 
• **Para Badminton Player of the Year: Qu Zimo (Female)**
 
• **Para Badminton Player of the Year: Leani Ratri Oktila**
 
• **Para Badminton Pair of the Year: Lucas Mazur and Faustine Noel**
